questions.prompt: Explain why the method used to extract a metal depends on its position in the reactivity series.
questions.modelAnswer: Very reactive metals (like Na, Al) form very stable compounds that carbon can’t reduce, so they need electrolysis of the molten compound, which uses a lot of energy. Metals of middle reactivity (Zn, Fe) have oxides that carbon (more reactive) can reduce. Metals of low reactivity (Cu, Hg) can be obtained just by heating their ores, and the least reactive (Ag, Au) are found free.
rubric: Low: heat alone or found free
